sloka: पद्भ्याम् रामो महारण्ये वत्सो मे विचरिष्यति ।यस्य त्वाहारसमये सूदाः कुण्डलधारिणः ॥२-१२-९८॥
transliteration: padbhyām rāmo mahāraṇye vatso me vicariṣyati ।yasya tvāhārasamaye sūdāḥ kuṇḍaladhāriṇaḥ ॥2-12-98॥

translations.english: How will my son for whom the cooks with kundalas in their ears used to proudly prepare enough food and beverages subsist on astringent, pungent, bitter wild fruits and roots?
